title: What Current AI Benchmarks Leave Unmeasured: Modality, Search, Citations, and Implications (for Safety Evaluations)
abstract: arXiv:2608.06202v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) benchmark evaluations are routinely used to support claims about model safety, reliability, and deployment readiness. Yet most evaluations rely on a single access modality (model APIs), perform a single run per prompt, and report accuracy as the primary outcome metric, without accounting for conditions such as web search that may have effects on model behavior in deployment. We audit these assumptions for one of the most widely-used LLMs, comparing two modalities, ChatGPT's chat UI and OpenAI's API, with and without web search enabled. We use a stratified total sample of 401 prompts from two popular benchmarks, BBQ and SafetyBench, collecting 4,812 total responses across three repeated runs per prompt. Beyond standard performance measures, we evaluate model output dimensions including response consistency, response text similarity, citation grounding, and abstention behavior. translated_title: 当前AI基准测试的未测量之处：模态、搜索、引用及其影响（对安全评估而言）
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）基准评估通常被用来支持关于模型安全性、可靠性和部署准备度的主张。然而，大多数评估依赖于单一访问模态（模型API），对每个提示词仅执行单次运行，并将准确率作为主要结果指标，而没有考虑诸如网络搜索等可能影响模型部署行为的条件。我们对使用最广泛的LLM之一进行了这些假设的审计，比较了两种模态——ChatGPT的聊天界面和OpenAI的API——在启用和禁用网络搜索条件下的表现。我们使用了来自两个流行基准BBQ和SafetyBench的401个提示词的分层总样本，在每个提示词三次重复运行中共收集了4,812个响应。除了标准性能指标外，我们还评估了模型输出的多个维度，包括响应一致性、响应文本相似度、引用依据和弃答行为。例如，聊天界面…
tldr: 该研究通过比较ChatGPT聊天界面与OpenAI API两种模态在有无网络搜索条件下的表现（涵盖401个提示词、4,812个响应），揭示了当前LLM基准评估所忽视的关键维度——如响应一致性、引用依据和弃答行为——并指出这些盲区对安全评估具有重要启示。
en_tdlr: This study audits the assumptions underlying current LLM benchmark evaluations by comparing ChatGPT's chat UI and OpenAI's API with and without web search across 401 prompts and 4,812 responses, revealing unmeasured dimensions such as response consistency, citation grounding, and abstention behavior, with important implications for safety evaluations.
